intro: Miss Doris was about to pour a kettle of hot water on her frozen windshield. Don't: it can crack it. One Saturday morning in October covers the whole winter. Here are 10 tricks before the first freeze: a 3-ingredient de-icer, the battery, the quarter test for tires, washer fluid, wipers, frozen doors and locks, coolant, the emergency kit, the half tank rule, and the tailpipe rule that saves lives. Plus driving on ice and getting unstuck. Episode 10 of "Miss Doris's Car".
chapters: Never do this to a frozen windshield
